props.name: items
props.description: One entry per position on the ring, spaced evenly.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the whole diagram.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Turn the other way — use it to make a second ring read as separate.

props.name: offset
props.description: Degrees to start from. Offsets a second ring so items never line up.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Stop while the diagram is hovered or focused, so items can be read.

props.name: showPath
props.description: Draw the path the items travel.
